instruction: Candid studio portrait, medium full shot. Against a light beige wall, two women sit on the floor. On the left, the woman with curly dark hair (R1) in a white shirt and jeans sits behind her companion, looking forward. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R3) in a black crop top and ripped jeans sits in front, eyes closed, touching her face. R1 rests her hand on R3's shoulder. Soft, even lighting creates a warm, serene mood.
elements: R1 sits behind R3 and rests her hand on R3's shoulder
R3 sits in front of R1 while R1 is behind her
R3 has her eyes closed and touches her own face
R1 looks forward while seated behind R3
The portrait is set against a light beige wall

questions.q: Is R1 resting her hand on R3's shoulder, rather than R3 resting her hand on R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1 rests her hand on R3's shoulder

questions.q: Is R1 seated behind R3 while making shoulder contact with R3, rather than R3 being behind R1 and contacting R1's shoulder?
questions.element: R1 is behind R3 and initiates the shoulder contact

questions.q: Is R3 seated in front of R1 while R1 sits behind her?
questions.element: R3 is in front and R1 is behind

questions.q: Is R3 touching her own face with her eyes closed while R1 looks forward behind her?
questions.element: R3 touches her face and closes her eyes while R1 looks forward
